summary: The row a SidePanel sits in: the content, then the panel. Gives the content column `min-width: 0` so wide content scrolls in place instead of pushing the panel off screen.
useWhen: a SidePanel opens beside a list, table or feed

useInstead.when: the side content is the app's navigation
useInstead.why: navigation belongs to the page shell, not to a content row

requires: exactly two children, content first and the SidePanel second — DOM order is reading and Tab order
guarantees: the first child fills the row and may shrink below its content's width, so a wide Table scrolls in its own container
adds no role and no landmark: the content and the panel carry their own names

antiPatterns.why: with the panel first, the detail is read and tabbed to before the list it is the detail of
